item.title: Overworld 0.3.0
item.description:
• Residents are sharper inside houses. Every class now has a sprite sheet at twice the detail, used the moment you open a house.
  • House signs and the opening title are drawn as crisp text at every zoom, the way bubbles already were. The chalk "+N" by the Hall is gone; the Hall card carries that count.
  • The remaining interior surfaces (stone, flagstones, rubble, iron, joists and the door) are redrawn at the finer detail, so a room reads evenly sharp.
  • At night, inside a house is now night: the walls take the cool dark of the hour instead of a sunset glow.
  • Residents have new poses in their sheets, leaning and sitting side-on. A stroll between terraces is built and tested but switched off in this release: no lane in today's town passes the visibility rules, so nobody strolls yet. Leaning and sitting at the café come in 0.3.1.
  • The first step toward a bigger-on-the-inside view of a house: interiors are laid out by a generator instead of fixed plans. Nothing visible changes yet.
  • The test suite runs faster and a test that could hang it is fixed. Not visible in the app.
